newsitem.title: UK: IPE natgas untraded, bids and offers wide apart.
newsitem.headline: IPE natgas untraded, bids and offers wide apart.

text.p: The IPE natural gas futures contract was untraded on Thursday morning.
Volumes in the two-hour morning session have been low all week. On Monday, there was also no trade in the morning.

By the midday close of the session, bids and offers were wide apart in all months. Front month June, which saw good volumes of trade on Wednesday, was bid at 9.90 pence a therm against offers 0.725 pence higher at 10.625 pence a therm.
